integrity: Proof is analytic; finite integer tests are supplementary, not an exhaustive certificate. Source comparisons report full and abstract access separately.
limitations: Applies to monomial symbols of integer degree at least two on complex Hardy H2; does not classify arbitrary Blaschke symbols or general composition products. Novelty has uneliminated archival priority uncertainty; no independent scientific audit.
title: Arithmetic spectral trichotomy for monomial composition–adjoint products
